implementation: One shared extension inventory request registry and selection receipt supports mandatory mcp/skills kind. Kind is part of immutable request identity and final snapshot correlation. No new persistent query state or Agent loop.

Skills uses the already reviewed official relay with fixed cli app-server --listen stdio://, then only initialize/clientInfo, initialized and skills/list(cwds=[exact canonical directory],forceReload=true). Closes stdin after the typed result and still waits for child success, group exit and both pipe EOFs.

Same whole-query 10 second deadline, 1 MiB stdout / 64 KiB stderr totals, depth32, 512 rows/errors. Nonblocking partial stdin writes share the actual child owner and cancel/TERM/KILL/cleanup path; late observer loss does not release activity or preparation scope early.

Selected Agent and known same-entry aliases acquire the existing preparation AccountScope. Existing locally known work, unsettled operation and candidate admission reject before dispatch. Idle connections are retained; external/unregistered entrypoints and remote idle notifications are not globally locked.

Only bounded pure text display metadata leaves private decoding: disabled rows, duplicate names, source category, sanitized names/descriptions and partial-error count. Error bodies, paths, initialization metadata, dependency commands/URLs, plugin IDs and unknown fields are not forwarded.
MCP launch arguments, output schema, selected environment and pre-existing process cleanup semantics remain unchanged apart from required operation.kind=mcp.

covered: Fixed request sequence, initialized ordering, exact cwd, partial writes/WouldBlock, fragmented JSONL, notifications, rejected unexpected response IDs/server requests/duplicate known keys/deep JSON.

Real peer EOF/malformed output/RPC failure/stdout and stderr limit; meaningful short description selection and Unicode truncation; disabled and same-name sources; partial official error count; no raw path/error/dependencies/init data in serialized response.
Actual 10 second init deadline, cancellation while waiting for list and after receiving result but before process exit, failed exit rejection, leader exit while descendant still holds pipe.

Real controlled ACP connection with work and unsettled-operation leases, candidate admission; idle same-entry aliases blocked while unrelated script remains usable; observer abort retains scope/activity until the actual TERM-ignoring worker is killed/reaped.
validation.sourceStability: The frozen checkpoint was captured after targeted execution; this is not a full-tree before/after command hash claim. No source edits after checkpoint; independent and root integration own their exact before/after inventories.

actualWire.provenance: Parsed exactly one EXTENSION_INVENTORY_WIRE line from targeted-first.txt plus one SKILLS_INVENTORY_WIRE line from skills-first.txt. The JSON equals their key-disjoint merge. These intermediate logs remain byte-preserved; final suite repeats the same schema with new timestamps, without overwriting delivered wire.
actualWire.scope: Actual Rust serialized controlled process results, not an installed official program. Capabilities are from a deliberately unsupported fixture row (both unavailable); available UI cases are controlled frontend fixtures, not cross-language available-admission evidence.

officialStaticEvidence.version: Public OpenAI codex rust-v0.156.1 source; installed package identity previously inspected as @openai/codex0.156.1 via codex-acp1.13.1. Runtime does not pin versions or inspect executable hashes for admission.

Existing nonproject project_root_markers may alter that boundary. Controlled Git root with .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md is a suitable installed-query fixture; actual discovery remains for root to test.

officialStaticEvidence.invalidMinimum: A SKILL.md frontmatter with name but missing or empty description has a required-field parser error. Do not use colon-only malformed YAML because the official parser may repair common prose colons.
officialStaticEvidence.sideEffects: Normal official app-server startup may maintain official cache/state or other configuration-derived resources. This implementation sends no configuration/skills-write/auth/thread/turn RPC, adds no secret service environment, and does not promise zero disk writes.

limitations: Descriptions are plain text data, never executed or appended to a prompt. Deterministic masking recognizes certain private-looking tokens, exact reported paths and controls; arbitrary prose cannot be certified secret-free.

AccountScope covers the selected Agent and registered aliases with known identical entry identity, not all Codex executables, all shared-HOME accounts or independent external processes. Idle remote events may still occur.

The initialized capability describes a reviewed entry and prepared environment, not installed API compatibility or current conversation skill use. Unsupported, malformed, timed-out or failed official responses remain explicit failures.
The 7 second pending-cleanup observation is not a declaration that an OS child has stopped; actual owned resources remain until reap/group/pipe completion.
P39 is only extended for this official read surface. P40 enable/disable/install, P41 tools and other Agent/Windows coverage remain open.
